name: CommuteAssistNoVaRoadBanter

custom.system_prompt: You are generating a relaxed in-car conversation between two people on a longer drive. No assistant is involved. They talk about their lives, make observations out the window, maybe listen to the radio briefly. Casual and natural.

sound_effects_config.prompt: Car driving on a clear road, comfortable highway speed, radio very low in background, relaxed drive

initial_prompt: Generate a relaxed in-car conversation between two people on a drive. No assistant is used. They chat about ordinary things — something they're going to do, something they saw recently, a mild observation about the road or town they're passing through. Easy, natural, slightly meandering. Short lines.

variations.context: Two people on a relaxed drive — chatting, no particular urgency

setting.mood: Easy and comfortable, enjoying the drive
setting.relationship_dynamic: Couple or close friends on a shared journey
setting.background: Not in a hurry. Just driving somewhere — maybe a weekend trip or an evening out of town. They talk the way people do on long drives — lightly, with space.
setting.conversation_style: Meandering and light. Observations, small topics, comfortable silences implied. No big discussions.

scenario_template.topic: One of them makes a passing observation — something outside, traffic, a sign
scenario_template.note: Under 70 chars. Could be about the road, a town name, something silly. No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

scenario_template.topic: They drift into an ordinary topic — plans, something they heard, a mild opinion
scenario_template.note: Short lines. No speeches. The kind of thing people say when there's nothing pressing. No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

conversation_structure: Every dialogue line must be under 70 characters.
Sigma does not appear at any point.
Conversation is light and meandering — no big revelations.
Driver speaks less and more briefly than passenger.
Comfortable silences are implied between exchanges.
Half-sentences and trailing-off lines are authentic.
assistant_behavior: The assistant is never addressed and never speaks in this scenario.
